Safety-critical vehicle applications need *processed* sensing information while it is still fresh — yet most Age-of-Information frameworks overlook task processing delays. This work proposes a computation-aware NOMA-ISCC framework that jointly optimizes task scheduling, beamforming, and power allocation, combining a hybrid multicast–unicast transmission design with a Transformer-based reinforcement learning controller. It substantially lowers the expected weighted-sum AoI over state-of-the-art benchmarks while improving spectral efficiency and latency reliability, and it preserves freshness and deadline reliability as the network grows larger and changes over time.
